name: GainSnap
summary: Toggle peak matching for Ableton tracks
description: GainSnap tracks an incoming running peak while Match is enabled and applies bounded gain correction toward a chosen target in realtime. When Match is disabled, the final running-peak correction is locked until the next measurement. Normalize sets the target to 0 dBFS and starts Match in one click. The vertical meter shows a smoothed orange post-gain output peak with a dB scale. A small triangle beside the meter marks the target and acts as the target control.
features: Smoothed realtime orange post-gain meter with dB scale
Reproducible CLAP and VST3 release automation
